title: Golden Rule becomes the Young Tuxedo Band
summary: The band played local balls, became the Young Tuxedo Band, then spread into orchestras with Lloyd Cottrell and Don Albert.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, what kind of jobs did you play with this Golden Rule band?
Well, it was all local, balls, banquets we call them, every Monday, regular dance. And then that band stretched out from the Golden Rule, they went into the Young Tuxedo Band with it.

Yeah. Still a sad man? Yeah, majority of the same men, yeah. Yeah. We made that band into the Young Tuxedo Band. And then we just add two more men stood. That's by adding a piano, a fella by the name of Dwight Newman.

Yeah. And then with all the bands, that was, and getting to late 20s then, we all stretched out into orchestras.
